# P32.21 — Measure a gap-closing acquisition pilot

**Requirement ids:** SIG-ACQ-004 ·
**ADR:** ADR-140 (the acquisition-pilot batch contract — family-granularity
selection, ceilings, funnel + gap-ledger schemas, the `sig.acq-pilot-return-pass/1`
gate packet, recommendation vocabulary, descriptive-only labelling) ·
**Base:** `devin/p32-20-san-diego-evidence-dossier` (stacked on PR #177 —
merge this after #177) ·
**Run:** `implement-spec spec=docs/tickets/182_P32.21__source-pilot-and-maintenance-decision.md live_verification=false` ·
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/182_P32.21__source-pilot-and-maintenance-decision.md` (manifest row 182, Round 10 / S5) ·
**PR:** #178 — https://github.com/SteveVitali/Eleutheria/pull/178 (OPEN/stacked; not merged)

## What this does

Delivers the **measured acquisition pilot** — the second stage on the P32.11
reviewed queue (`tasks.acquisition`). A new module
`tasks/src/tasks/acquisition_pilot.py` selects the bounded first batch, measures
the acquisition funnel + maintenance burden over committed artifacts, reconciles
unique gap contributions at fact granularity, renders per-family
continue/stop/improve recommendations, and emits the exact gate packets for the
bounded live slices. `live_verification=false`: no fetch, no rights flip, no
records request, no spend, no publication, no fabricated approval or review —
every live slice is a `prepared_not_executed` gate packet pinned to an OPEN
deferral, not an executed acquisition.

### Batch — `acq-pilot-batch/1` (`acq-pilot-select/1`)

Five families under the ticket's hard ceilings (≤5 total incl. the three pilot
cities, ≤2 incremental non-portfolio, ≤10 approved documents/aggregate rows per
family, ≤2 new protocol families — observed: 5 = 3 portfolio + 2 incremental,
0 new protocols):

- **Portfolio slot (P-SEL-1):** the three dossier-city municipal families —
  `okc` (SRC-001), `tulsa` (SRC-002), `san-diego` (SRC-003/004/005). Measured,
  never re-selected; their live slices stay owned by D-P32.18-1/19-1/20-1.
- **Contract/acquisition chain (P-SEL-2):** `oklahoma-state` — SRC-006 (OMES
  statewide contracts, the q5 contract-chain channel) + SRC-007 (the DAC UVED
  authority chain, the recorded P0-dossier gap). In-family award members
  SRC-008/SRC-009 are excluded with the recorded reason — no dossier gap ledger
  records a traceable award gap (the S5 funding-family precondition is unmet).
- **Independent oversight (P-SEL-3):** `california-state-auditor` — SRC-011, the
  inventory's only non-municipal independent provenance class.

Every other candidate is a recorded `RejectedAlternative` — `portfolio_member`,
`p31_owned` (SRC-023, SRC-026 — never re-onboarded), `duplicate`, `blocked`,
`preflight_screening_owed` (SRC-024/025), `prohibited_metadata_only`
(**SRC-027 stays metadata-only outside the acquired batch**),
`no_recorded_award_gap` (SRC-008/009/022), `outside_pilot_shapes`, or `capacity`
(SRC-010 Sourcewell and SRC-012 Seattle OIG are the ranked next-in-line —
expansion is a new scope decision).

### Funnel + maintenance burden — `acq-pilot-funnel/1`

Seven stages (discovery → candidate_qualification → approval_gate → capture →
extraction → link_support → publication_eligibility) per family, measured from
committed artifacts only: portfolio counts are `offline_replay` over the
committed dossier packets (`captured_live` = 0 for every family); incremental
stages are `pending_live` — expectations never count as closures. Approval
gates record `approval_refs=[]` and `decisions_recorded=0`. Maintenance burden
per family distinguishes **one-time setup** (effort estimate, never a measured
cost), **recurring maintenance** (refresh cadence + named owner) and
**measured_minutes** (always `None` — the `CostRecord` rule). Failed, 403,
rights-blocked, screening-owed and rights-undetermined targets stay visible
with reasons, a 2-per-target retry budget and the escalation path (recorded
rights/operator decision or the records channel — never a blind retry; no
broad blind crawler).

### Gap ledger — `acq-pilot-gap-ledger/1`

Before/after reconciliation at **fact granularity** — (question slug,
predicate, raw value) → asserting source families: unique vs shared support is
partitioned exactly (`double_counted=0`, `mirror_as_independent=0`,
`p31_duplicate_onboarding=0`). A slug supported by several source families is
shared, never double-counted as unique; a non-independent lineage class cannot
enter the batch.

### Gate packets — `sig.acq-pilot-return-pass/1`

`ACQ_PILOT_RETURN_PASS.json`, `prepared_not_executed`, deferral **D-P32.21-1**
(OPEN, cites BL-058): six targets across the two incremental families —
oklahoma-state (the OMES index + a statewide-contract document, the DAC UVED
program page + the OSCN statute-version document) and california-state-auditor
(the 2019-118 audit index + the agency-survey page) — with per-target goals,
caps, HG-03/Part-VIII/municipal-publication preconditions and explicit
non-goals (no rights flip, no gate completion, no request sent, no spend, no
publication, no crawler, no workbook/XLSX/ZIP/`sharedStrings` or row-level
plate/person/query transport). The three portfolio slices stay pinned to their
own OPEN rows. **`check_pilot` verifies the named deferrals exist as OPEN rows
in the committed `DEFERRALS.md`** — a gate packet naming an unregistered or
closed row fails.

### Recommendations — descriptive only

Per-family continue/stop/improve on unique supported gap closure + cost:
`okc` **continue** (34/36, release-valid, 14 unique assertions), `tulsa`
**improve** (honest 24/36 — the contract-chain gate stays unresolved by
design), `san-diego` **continue** (29/36 mechanical-complete; review not run),
`oklahoma-state` + `california-state-auditor` **continue** under recorded
conditions + stop rules. The preregistered S5 matched discovery comparison was
**not run** — every result is labelled descriptive only; no causal
superiority is claimed or implied. Expansion beyond this batch is a new scope
decision.
